source.description: The ID of the SCC source to which the IAM policy is attached.
source.rationale: Specifies the SCC source being secured. Incorrect or missing source values could result in IAM bindings not being applied to the intended findings source.

member/members.description: The identities being granted the role. Supported formats include user:{email}, group:{email}, serviceAccount:{email}, domain:{domain}, or project-level identifiers. Avoid allUsers and allAuthenticatedUsers as they grant broad access.
member/members.rationale: Defining correct members ensures least privilege. Using public principals exposes sensitive findings to unauthorized users.

role.description: The role assigned to the members. Must be a valid Security Command Center role or a custom role in the format [projects|organizations]/{parent}/roles/{role-name}.
role.rationale: Roles determine access scope. Using non-SCC roles or overly permissive roles can create security risks.

policy_data.description: An IAM policy data source to define multiple bindings at once.
policy_data.rationale: When used, policy_data ensures consistent IAM application. If misconfigured, it can unintentionally override other bindings.
